proof_body:
by
  intro R _ _
  constructor
  · intro h e he
    have hc : IsClopen ((PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e : Set (PrimeSpectrum R))) := PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.2 ⟨e, he, rfl⟩
    rcases isClopen_iff.1 hc with h0 | h1
    · left
      have hn : IsNilpotent e := (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen_eq_bot_iff e).1 (SetLike.coe_injective h0)
      obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := hn
      have : ∀ k : ℕ, e ^ (k + 1) = e := fun k => by
        induction k with
        | zero => simp
        | succ k ih => rw [pow_succ, ih, he.eq]
      cases n with
      | zero => simp at hn
      | succ n => rwa [this n] at hn
    · right
      have hu : IsUnit e := by
        by_contra hne
        obtain ⟨m, hm, hem⟩ := exists_max_ideal_of_mem_nonunits hne
        have hx : (⟨m, hm.isPrime⟩ : PrimeSpectrum R) ∈ (PrimeSpectrum.basicOpen e : Set (PrimeSpectrum R)) := by
          rw [h1]; trivial
        exact hx hem
      exact hu.mul_left_cancel (by rw [he.eq, mul_one])
  · intro h
    have hp : PreconnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R) := by
      refine (preconnectedSpace_iff_clopen).2 fun s hs => ?_
      obtain ⟨e, he, rfl⟩ := PrimeSpectrum.isClopen_iff.1 hs
      rcases h e he with rfl | rfl
      · left; simp
      · right; simp
    exact { toPreconnectedSpace := hp, toNonempty := inferInstance }
target_source: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [Nontrivial R], ConnectedSpace (PrimeSpectrum R) ↔ ∀ e : R, IsIdempotentElem e → e = 0 ∨ e = 1
